events.summary: Action-state compression, strategic silence and minimum-disclosure communication collided with direct prior art; no implementation was justified.
AgnosticEngine production loads; failures are isolated to an editorial workflow, while the core commercial path and paid intent remain unverified.
Paid public discovery and provincial aggregation validated demand but also increased institutional-substitution risk.
Lifecycle moved to BLOCKED until at least three real RoboDK station executions are completed.
The prospective-trigger compiler was killed before implementation after prior-art collision; the frontier reset to E1.
An official container route exists, but real simulator execution remains unavailable in the current runtime.
Partition-invariance repair was killed by earlier metamorphic-testing prior art.
A first public-capex precursor chain was found before later CAE monetization; broader benchmarking remains required.
Real simulator execution became the only technical gate; no F5 without at least three completed runs.
The execution judge now separates program validity, collision checks and simulated timing without claiming controller-grade accuracy.
